query:
SELECT i.id, i.protocol AS "protocol: Protocol", i.tag, i.port, i.settings, i.stream,
                  n.host AS node_host
           FROM "Inbound" i
           JOIN "Node" n ON n.id = i."nodeId"
           WHERE i.enable = true
             AND i.protocol::text = ANY($1::text[])
             AND n.active = true
             -- Status hysteresis: nodes that dropped offline moments ago stay
             -- in subscriptions for a grace period, so a brief flap does not
             -- make clients lose (and regain) whole nodes on every refresh.
             AND (n.status = 'ONLINE'
                  OR (n.status = 'OFFLINE' AND n."updatedAt" > $3))
             AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "ClientInbound" ci
                         WHERE ci."inboundId" = i.id AND ci."clientId" = $2 AND ci.enable = true)
           ORDER BY i."createdAt" ASC, i.id ASC
